text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I visited the library to return the borrowed materials—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my.
Do you have business in the library too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I came to read some history books.
Actually, this library quietly holds quite an extensive collection
in that subject..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I have some free time,
I often put it to good use like this.
choice_data_list: You really like history books, huh.
You really like history books, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I find it deeply captivating.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The deeds of people in the past turned into books, surviving
long enough to reach us living in the 'now'...
Just that fact alone makes my heart tremble—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Delving into the contents and reflecting on the lives of people back then, as well as the emotions of the historians who wrote them down, brings an exhilarating sense of expanding my own world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Every time I read it, I feel inspired to
live just as sincerely in this world—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It gives me something akin to the courage... needed to live my "now" to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan spoke with a joyful tone.
Seeing her like that made me want to experience
the feeling she was talking about, too—
choice_data_list: I kinda want to read some history books too.
I'd like to read some history books too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...!
Is that true?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case...
If it's alright with you—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me to assist you
in searching for the book you wish to read, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
For example, do you have any requests like,
"I want to read a history book that feels like this"?
I'd be happy to recommend something to the best of my knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan is sure to know plenty of history
books. It would be wise to take her up on her offer
and ask for recommendations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I were to read a history book—
choice_data_list: I want to read something full of twists and turns.
I want to read something for beginners.
I want to read Aldan's favorite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Something full of ups and downs...
Perhaps a story dealing with the rise and fall
of nations would meet your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The way the individual choices of people facing the survival of their
community accumulate into a great swell that changes history
is truly tumultuous—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have a few candidates in mind.
Shall we take a look right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I had Mejiro Ardan pick out some recommendations for me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reading while recalling Mejiro Ardan's words,
I felt as if I had truly connected with
the things she held dear...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: For beginners... something focusing on the history of a specific person might fit what you're looking for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Just as you experience a story through the characters
in a novel, you can experience history through
the lives of those who lived it—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I have a few candidates in mind.
Shall we take a look right away?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I had Mejiro Ardan pick out some recommendations for me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reading while recalling Mejiro Ardan's words,
I felt as if I had truly connected with
the things she held dear...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My favorite...!
I certainly don't mind that, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What should we do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's embarrassing to admit, but, well...
I have so many favorites...
that it's hard to narrow it down to just one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I've rarely had the chance to
recommend history books to anyone before... so—"
choice_data_list: Then maybe I'll ask about all the recommended spots

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. In that case, I will introduce, with all my heart, each and every point that I recommend……!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Mejiro Ardan kicked off a grand presentation extravaganza on history books—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Ardan recommend it with such delight,
I felt as though I had touched upon something truly precious to her...
